summary: Recursively traverses a collision-tree node chain. For each node it calls ShadowVolumeExtrusion (00448730), then scans four consecutive child pointers starting at offset 0x4C and recurses into each non-null child via CollisionTreeTraversal. It then follows the next/sibling pointer at offset 0x5C, looping until that link is null, and returns the final sibling value. Invoked by CollisionContactResponse (00449700).

local_names.v2: pointer to the first child slot (this + 19, offset 0x4C)

operations.description: Outer infinite while loop that walks the node chain until the sibling link at offset 0x5C is null.
Call ShadowVolumeExtrusion (00448730) with this as the current node.
Inner do-while loop over four consecutive child pointers starting at this + 19 (offset 0x4C), counting down from 4.
For each child slot, skip the recursive call when the child pointer is null.
Recursively call CollisionTreeTraversal (00448DA0) for each non-null child pointer.
Read result = this[23] (offset 0x5C), the next/sibling node link.
If the sibling link result is null, break out of the outer while loop.
Follow the sibling link: this = (pointer)this[23] (offset 0x5C) for the next outer iteration.
Return the final sibling value result read before the loop terminated.
